description: This file contains the implementation of a Orleans grain called ChainedGrain, including its state class ChainedGrainState and associated methods for chaining and validation.

classes.name: ChainedGrainState
classes.description: Serializable class representing the state of the ChainedGrain, including Id, X, and reference to the next grain.

classes.name: ChainedGrain
classes.description: Orleans grain class implementing the IChainedGrain interface, providing chained computation and state validation methods.

methods.name: GetNext
methods.description: Returns the next grain in the chain.

methods.name: GetId
methods.description: Returns the Id of the grain.

methods.name: GetX
methods.description: Returns the X value stored in the grain.

methods.name: GetCalculatedValue
methods.description: Recursively calculates the sum of X values along the chain.

methods.name: SetNext
methods.description: Sets the next grain in the chain.

methods.name: SetNextNested
methods.description: Sets the next grain in the chain based on a nested holder.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates the state of the chain (whether next is set appropriately).

methods.name: PassThis
methods.description: Passes this grain as the next to another grain.

methods.name: PassNull
methods.description: Sets the next of another grain to null.

methods.name: PassThisNested
methods.description: Passes this grain as the next in a nested chain.

methods.name: PassNullNested
methods.description: Sets the next in a nested chain to null.
